title: Generalized Bawo: A Finite-State Model and an EXPTIME Upper Bound
summary: Four-row mancala games, including Malawian Bawo and the related East African Bao, have received limited attention in computational complexity theory despite their combinatorial richness. This paper introduces GENERALIZED-BAWO-WIN, a finite-state two-player game model inspired by Malawian Bawo. The model is parameterized by a half-board width n and a binary-encoded lap cap L, and incorporates relay sowing, marker-pit capture, a formalized capture-relay rule (abstracting kichwa), mandatory capture, a singleton-start prohibition, and an explicit lap-cap truncation rule that guarantees move…
